howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你设计审查工作流，发现并减少 AI 输出中的偏见。它提供检测方法、排查原因和验证修复效果。
howto.when: 当你请求设计 AI 输出偏见检测工作流，或询问如何发现和减少偏见时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个偏见检测审查流程。
say.note: Claude 会输出工作流步骤和检查清单。

say.text: 怎么比较测试不同人群的AI输出偏见？
say.note: Claude 介绍对比测试方法。

say.text: 发现偏见后如何分析根本原因？
say.note: Claude 从数据、提示等多个角度排查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design review workflows to surface and mitigate bias in AI outputs. It provides detection methods, root cause analysis, and verification steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design a bias detection workflow for AI outputs, or inquire about finding and reducing bias.

say_en.text: Design a bias detection review workflow for me.
say_en.note: Claude outputs workflow steps and checklists.

say_en.text: How to compare AI outputs for bias across different groups?
How to find root cause after detecting bias?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes from data, prompts, etc.
